_comment: Project hooks approved by Vinay 2026-09-03 (prompt audit, hunk 22). They enforce in code what CLAUDE.md states in prose: 6.2/6.3 (no deletion of tracked VTU/PRJ or any .md), 7 (no Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer), and xmllint after every PRJ edit (memory: incident_xml_double_hyphen_comment_parse). Commands were pipe-tested against real and synthetic inputs before being written.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.prj) xmllint --noout "$f" || { echo "xmllint failed on $f: check for a -- inside an XML comment (memory: incident_xml_double_hyphen_comment_parse)" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -Eq "(^|[;&|[:space:]])(git[[:space:]]+)?rm[[:space:]].*(Tests/Data/[^[:space:]]*\.(vtu|prj)|\.md)([[:space:]]|$)"; then echo "Blocked by CLAUDE.md 6.2/6.3: never delete tracked VTU/PRJ files or any .md file; annotate as historical instead" >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -Eq "git[[:space:]]+commit" && printf "%s" "$c" | grep -Eq "(^|[\n])[[:space:]]*Co-Authored-By: Claude|--trailer[= ]+[\"']?Co-Authored-By: Claude"; then echo "Blocked by CLAUDE.md 7: no Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer unless Vinay explicitly asked for one" >&2; exit 2; fi
